gloss: to call out to someone; to speak to; to invite along

definitions.gloss: to call out to someone; to speak to someone first
definitions.explanation: To address someone who was not already talking with you — to get their attention, greet them, or offer help. The person is marked with に.

definitions.gloss: to invite along; to let someone know about an occasion
definitions.explanation: To ask someone to join an outing, a project, or a team. Common in {今度|こんど}{声|こえ}をかけてね, 'let me know next time.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけた。
examples.english: I spoke to someone who seemed to be in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけられて⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was startled when a stranger suddenly spoke to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ようだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}って→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけてみた。
examples.english: They looked lost, so I worked up the nerve to call out to them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧とき⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけて⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: Give me a shout next time you go out drinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいなかった。
examples.english: I asked several people, but none of them were free.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦にあたって→にあたって：22936_niatatte⟧、⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけた。
examples.english: In starting the new project, I approached a colleague with experience about joining.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + かける (to cast, to apply).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{声|こえ}をかける: to speak to ~, to invite ~
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけられる: to be spoken to (the passive is very common)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to look out for one another by speaking up
- お⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧がけ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please let me know (polite; the noun form ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧がけ)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is a soft way to ask to be included — ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧をかけて⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ leaves the other person free to decide, unlike a direct ⟦{誘|さそ}って→誘う：01947_sasou⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧. In disaster-preparedness and workplace-safety contexts, ⟦{声|こえ}かけ→声かけ：12146_koekake⟧ is a set term for checking on the people around you.
